mentions.name: Superdocs
mentions.description: This app extracts key information from PDFs and highlights citations. Users provide a PDF and a JSON schema defining what to extract, and it returns the extracted values, citations, and their precise locations in the document. It handles complex layouts such as multiple columns, tables, and scanned documents, and is planned to be offered both as an API and a self-hosted option for organizations with strict data privacy requirements.
mentions.problem: Verification of LLM-extracted information is critical in workflows such as legal and finance.
mentions.audience: Workflows where verification of LLM-extracted information is critical, such as legal and finance; organizations with strict data privacy requirements.
